title: Minimum Payments Are a $19,000 Trap by Design
hook: Paying just the minimum on a $5,000 credit card balance costs you $19,000 in interest and takes 22 years — and the bank deliberately hid that math in the fine print.
angle: Exposes how minimum payment amounts are calculated to maximize bank interest, not help you pay off debt, with the exact compounding math most people never see
audience: Anyone carrying a credit card balance — roughly 45% of card holders
key_numbers: 22 years to pay off at minimum payments
Just $50 extra/month cuts payoff to 4 years
